mutants.category: Wishbone B4 & Avalon-MM Interconnect / ALU ANDI Decode
mutants.description: Wishbone B4 & Avalon-MM byte lane masking and address alignment decoding bug: OP_ANDI decodes to ALU_OR instead of ALU_AND, corrupting byte enable calculations and address alignment masks, causing byte masking operations to bitwise-OR instead of bitwise-AND
